text:
Alice Chen: FYI customer acme-corp opened a ticket — their billing page shows zero usage for several of their services starting ~02:00 UTC. They say dashboards also empty.

Ben K.: putting in triage now. ticket #CS-7889. any recent deploys to analytics?

SRE Bot: deploy-redwood-analytics v4.12 rolled at 01:45 UTC to prod (canary->all).

Maya R.: I can repro quickly in console: run org=acme, hourly view returns empty rows after 02:05.

Diego (data): Checked Kafka consumer group "usage-hourly-consumers" offsets — there's a lag on partition 3 ~ 2.5M msgs. Looks like consumer crashed and restarted at 02:10 and fell behind.

Ben K.: any errors in consumer logs?

Diego (data): paste: ```
[2026-03-16T02:09:58Z] ERROR ConsumerLoop - Unhandled exception java.lang.OutOfMemoryError
... java heap after GC 95% used
[2026-03-16T02:10:01Z] INFO ConsumerRestart - restarting consumer group member
```

Maya R.: ok that matches. Hourly ETL depends on that consumer to write hourly_rollups table. If it's behind, console will show empty windows.

Alice Chen: customer is asking for ETA. Can we prioritize backfill?

Diego (data): I can kick off a targeted backfill for tenant acme. Steps: 1) pause live consumer on group, 2) run backfill job for tenant_id=acme from 02:00->now, 3) resume consumer. Backfill should take ~30-45m for this tenant.

Ben K.: do it. Please share commands so I can track.

Diego (data): running now. Command: ```
kubectl exec -it job-runner -- /app/backfill --tenant acme --start 2026-03-16T02:00:00Z --end 2026-03-16T04:30:00Z --mode incremental
```

SRE Bot: job backfill-acme started (job-id: j-20260316-824).

Maya R.: while that's running, quick check — no DB schema migrations touched hourly_rollups last deploy right?

Diego (data): confirmed no schema changes. The OOM was due to increased batch size hitting a memory regression in v4.12 consumer. I'll open a fix PR to cap batch size.

Alice Chen: customer update (to acme): "We identified a consumer crash causing an ETL backlog. We're running a targeted backfill now; expected appearance in console within 45 minutes. Apologies for the disruption." (sent) :pray:

Ben K.: backfill progress log: "processed 1200 partitions, processed 1.2M events, 40% complete". ETA ~28m.

Diego (data): backfill finished. Output: ```
Processed 3,120,457 events for tenant acme
Inserted 18,432 hourly_rollup rows
Duration: 00:27:14
```

Maya R.: verified dashboard now shows hourly rows from 02:00 onwards for acme. Billing page values restored.

Alice Chen: customer notified and closing ticket pending confirmation. They replied: "Thanks, visibility returned. Please keep us posted on root cause."

Diego (data): root cause: memory regression in consumer v4.12; mitigation: roll back consumer JVM flag and limit max.batch.size. PR #2214 opened, will patch and schedule a canary tomorrow.

Ben K.: follow-ups: add alert on consumer OOM rate, add automated consumer restart cooldown, and add targeted backfill runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/etl-targeted-backfill

Alice Chen: tagging the runbook in the ticket. closing on our side after 24h verification :thumbsup:
